clips.title: 摩根士丹利策略师：市场无视地缘冲突 牛市根基未变

subtitles.en: Mike Wilson of Market Stanley writing, if there is a stable resolution in the Middle East, the bond market might walk back the Fed hike it's currently pricing in.
subtitles.zh: 摩根士丹利的威尔逊写道，如果中东局势稳定解决，债市可能会回撤当前定价的加息幅度。
zh_highlights: 回撤当前定价的加息幅度
en_highlights: stable resolution in the Middle East

subtitles.en: Our conviction in the current bull market is intact.
subtitles.zh: 我们对当前牛市的信心不变。

subtitles.en: Mike joins us now for more. Mike always great to see you. Thanks for being here.
subtitles.zh: 威尔逊现在加入我们。很高兴见到你，感谢你的到来。

subtitles.en: Let's start there. This idea of what a bull market means.
subtitles.zh: 我们先从牛市的意义谈起。

subtitles.en: Does it mean stocks just go up into the right or does this mean that there is some sort of cyclical undercurrent that shows an economy that truly is strengthening?
subtitles.zh: 这是否意味着权益资产只是向右上行，还是存在某种周期性暗流，显示经济真正在走强？

subtitles.en: Well, let's go back to why we're in a bull market. It's all about the recovery from the rolling recession from a year ago, this operating leverage story.
subtitles.zh: 回顾我们为何处于牛市：这完全源于一年前滚动式衰退后的复苏，即经营杠杆的故事。

subtitles.en: It's an earnings driven bull market, right? So last year we got the multiple expansion in advance of predicting that that was going to happen.
subtitles.zh: 这是一个盈利驱动的牛市。去年我们在预测盈利增长之前，估值已经先行扩张。

subtitles.en: And as you recall going into this year, there were a lot of kind of boobards on the economy.
subtitles.zh: 回想今年年初，市场上有很多对经济的悲观论调。

subtitles.en: People were very nervous about earnings. And we were, it was like the opposite of you.
subtitles.zh: 人们对盈利非常紧张，而我们当时持相反观点。

subtitles.en: I mean, nominal GDP is booming. It's seven to eight percent and that's in place.
subtitles.zh: 名义GDP正在蓬勃发展，达到7%到8%，而且这一趋势仍在持续。

subtitles.en: So what's going on now is the multiple is coming down, over the last six months.
subtitles.zh: 现在的情况是，过去六个月估值倍数在下降。

subtitles.en: But the earnings have been so good that the market can still go up.
subtitles.zh: 但盈利表现非常好，市场仍能上涨。

subtitles.en: So the next phase of the bull market at this stage, typically is multiples are flat to down.
subtitles.zh: 牛市下一阶段，通常估值倍数持平或下降。

subtitles.en: Earnings come through as expected, but that can drive the earnings stock market higher.
subtitles.zh: 盈利如预期兑现，就能推动市场走高。

subtitles.en: And you get rotations to the areas where that earnings growth is underappreciated.
subtitles.zh: 资金会轮动到盈利增长被低估的领域。

subtitles.en: And we think that yesterday's action is some evidence that maybe we're going to have that next rotation.
subtitles.zh: 我们认为昨天的走势表明可能迎来下一轮轮动。

subtitles.en: We've already had several rotations this year. And we think that next rotation is in some of the areas you mentioned, like regional banks or consumer goods, which are asymmetrically positively inspired
subtitles.zh: 今年已有多次轮动，下一轮可能在你提到的区域银行或消费品，这些板块因油价下跌而获得不对称正面提振。
因油价下跌而获得不对称正面提振。
